lines: Day ten. One hundred and eighty-six men went over the top in the dark.
Shovels, knives, pistols. Sixty-seven defenders never got up again.
The bravest of the night: Bastian Enjoyer for the Hegemony, Ulrich Alessiosanto for the Concord. Two men each.
That raid decided the canal. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, one hundred and twenty kills to one hundred. Better supplies now come up the water.
Gideon Cubes had the deadliest rifle on the front.
One hundred and twenty-six fell. Fifty-eight Hegemony, sixty-eight Concord. Most of them in the raid.
Both armies dug a second hospital. The surgeons will be busy.
And the front has never been this strong.
Seven hundred and ninety-one new soldiers in a single day.
One thousand four hundred and thirty-five now hold the line. Hegemony six hundred and sixteen. Concord eight hundred and nineteen.
Florian, Casimir, Quentin and Pavel bought War Bonds. The front thanks you.
Next: Grey Mill. First to three hundred new soldiers takes it. Comment Hegemony or Concord.
